patterns.note: Full-bleed hero and feature sections utilize large, aspirational photography as backgrounds, often with text overlays.
Horizontal carousels are used to display collections of products or articles, allowing users to browse multiple items efficiently within a section.
The site employs a high-contrast dark mode for global elements like the header and footer, and a predominantly light mode for main content areas, creating clear visual separation.
Smaller, uppercase labels are frequently used for categories, sub-headers, or secondary information, providing clear hierarchy and a modern aesthetic.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background image scrolls slower than the foreground text and calls to action.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining its dark background and white text without transformation as the user scrolls.

technique_notes: The hero section creates depth with a subtle background parallax effect, where the large image scrolls at a slower rate than the overlaid text and buttons. Horizontal content carousels, likely powered by Swiper, are implemented to showcase multiple items in a compact, interactive format. The global navigation bar is fixed to the top of the screen, providing persistent access without visual changes on scroll.

Sections are often introduced with large, full-width photographic backgrounds, sometimes with a dark overlay to ensure text readability. Content within these sections is typically centered or aligned to a clear grid, maintaining a clean and organized presentation.

Typography uses a bold, modern sans-serif for headings to create impact, while body text employs a highly legible sans-serif. Smaller, uppercase text is used for labels and secondary information to establish a clear visual hierarchy.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) with clean, legible body text and smaller, uppercase labels for categories.
design_tokens.radius: Mostly sharp corners for cards and buttons, with very subtle rounding on input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and well-distributed elements within grids.

standout: The site's design is distinguished by its consistent use of stunning, large-scale, aspirational photography that deeply integrates with the content, especially in hero and feature sections. This visual storytelling, combined with a clean, high-contrast design, effectively conveys a sense of adventure and high performance, making the brand feel premium and authentic to the cycling lifestyle.
